description: Defines classes and methods for creating and writing minidump files, including file handling, string writing, memory copying, and managing minidump object chunks, used in crash dump generation with Google Breakpad.

classes.name: MinidumpFileWriter
classes.description: Handles file operations and writing data to minidump files.

classes.name: UntypedMDRVA
classes.description: Represents an untyped memory chunk allocated within a minidump.

classes.name: TypedMDRVA<MDType>
classes.description: Manages typed memory chunks for specific MDType objects within a minidump.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file for minidump writing at the specified path.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Sets an existing file descriptor as the minidump output.

methods.name: WriteString
methods.description: Writes a string (UTF-8 or wide char) to the minidump.

methods.name: WriteMemory
methods.description: Writes raw memory data into the minidump.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the minidump at a specified position.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a memory region within the minidump.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the minidump at the current position.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for a specific MDType object.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for an MDType object plus additional bytes.

methods.name: AllocateArray
methods.description: Allocates memory for an array of MDType objects.

methods.name: AllocateObjectAndArray
methods.description: Allocates memory for an MDType object followed by an array.

methods.name: CopyIndex
methods.description: Copies an MDType item into an array at a specified index.

methods.name: CopyIndexAfterObject
methods.description: Copies data into an array after an object MDType.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Writes the current data to the minidump file.
